description: Conformance vectors for icp-merkle:v1, the tree rules behind apps/02_merkle_anchor. The specification is protocol/MERKLE_V1.md. `trees` pin roots and every audit path; `multiproofs` pin the multiproof encoding; `reject` pins which inputs are refused and how. Generated by protocol/tools/merkle-vectors.mjs.

trees.name: duplicate-leaves
trees.description: the same leaf value three times: every position is provable; positions 0 and 1 share a path because they share a value and a sibling

trees.name: last-leaf-repeated
trees.description: size-3 with its last leaf repeated; under a duplicate-the-odd-node rule this would share size-3's root (CVE-2012-2459), here it does not

trees.name: large-100000
trees.description: a large batch; leaves are derived with leafRule rather than listed

trees.name: uniform-1000000
trees.description: the anchor's maximum leafCount, every leaf identical; exercises a 20-hash path, not index binding

multiproofs.name: single-leaf
multiproofs.description: one leaf: the same hashes as its audit path, in walk order

multiproofs.name: first-and-last
multiproofs.description: the two ends of an unbalanced tree

multiproofs.name: adjacent-run
multiproofs.description: three neighbours share most of their paths

multiproofs.name: every-leaf
multiproofs.description: every leaf of a perfect tree: nothing left to prove, the proof is empty

multiproofs.name: duplicate-values
multiproofs.description: two positions holding the same value

multiproofs.name: large-spread
multiproofs.description: three leaves of the large tree

reject.name: corrupted-leaf
reject.description: one bit of the leaf value flipped

reject.name: corrupted-path
reject.description: one bit of a path hash flipped

reject.name: corrupted-root
reject.description: one bit of the anchored root flipped

reject.name: wrong-index
reject.description: the proof for leaf 2 presented as leaf 3

reject.name: wrong-size
reject.description: the right proof against a tree two levels deeper
reject.error: a proof for leaf 2 of 9 has exactly 4 hashes, got 3

reject.name: path-too-long
reject.error: a proof for leaf 2 of 7 has exactly 3 hashes, got 4

reject.name: path-too-short
reject.error: a proof for leaf 2 of 7 has exactly 3 hashes, got 2

reject.name: short-path-hash
reject.error: path[0] must be exactly 32 bytes, got 31

reject.name: index-outside-tree
reject.description: leaf index equal to the leaf count
reject.error: leaf index must be an integer in 0..6, got 7

reject.name: leaf-hash-as-leaf
reject.description: the leaf hash presented as the leaf value

reject.name: interior-node-as-leaf
reject.description: an interior node of size-4 presented as leaf 0 with its real sibling
reject.error: a proof for leaf 0 of 4 has exactly 2 hashes, got 1

reject.name: multi-missing-hash
reject.error: the multiproof has too few hashes

reject.name: multi-unsorted
reject.error: multiproof leaf indices must be strictly increasing

reject.name: multi-duplicate-index
reject.error: multiproof leaf indices must be strictly increasing

reject.name: multi-empty
reject.error: a multiproof must prove at least one leaf

reject.name: multi-outside-tree
reject.description: an index equal to the leaf count
reject.error: leaf index 3 must be an integer in 0..16, got 17

reject.name: multi-shifted-index
reject.description: the right leaves claimed one position to the right
